title: The three Spotlight fonts were preloaded on every route

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-cwv finder). app/layout.tsx declared Playfair Display, Caveat and Space Grotesk through next/font without preload: false, while the comment two lines below records that the five theme-only faces carry it for exactly this reason; so every public page shipped three <link rel=preload> font fetches ahead of its LCP for faces only a Spotlight draws. CLOSED 2026-10-05: preload: false on all three; the @font-face still loads where a glyph is used.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/layout.tsx","utf8");const bad=["Playfair_Display(","Caveat(","Space_Grotesk("].filter((f)=>{const i=s.indexOf(f);return i<0||!s.slice(i,i+220).includes("preload: false")});if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-676: "+bad.join(", ")+" preload on every route: a <link rel=preload> per Spotlight face in the head of pages that never use them, ahead of the LCP.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
